new_entities.name: SGLT2 inhibitor therapy in HFpEF
aliases: empagliflozin or dapagliflozin in preserved-EF heart failure
SGLT2 inhibition for HFpEF or HFmrEF
new_entities.description: Use of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction.

new_entities.name: Heart-failure hospitalization
new_entities.description: Hospital admission or urgent worsening-heart-failure event requiring escalation of care.

edges.effect_quant: Across EMPEROR-Preserved and DELIVER, SGLT2 inhibition consistently reduced heart-failure worsening and hospitalization; EMPEROR-Preserved lowered total HF hospitalizations with HR 0.73, and DELIVER lowered worsening HF with HR 0.79.
edges.population: adults with symptomatic heart failure and left ventricular ejection fraction above 40%, including HFmrEF and HFpEF
edges.mechanism: SGLT2 inhibition appears to reduce congestion and improve cardiorenal hemodynamics, lowering recurrent decompensation risk even in patients without reduced ejection fraction.
edges.summary: This is one of the cleanest modern HFpEF benefit signals. The dominant benefit is fewer heart-failure hospitalizations and urgent worsening-HF events rather than a large clear mortality reduction.
edges.caveats: Most of the effect is driven by hospitalization outcomes, while cardiovascular mortality reductions are smaller and often not individually significant. The edge therefore focuses on hospitalization prevention rather than a broad cure-all framing.

evidence.citation: Anker SD et al 2021 N Engl J Med
evidence.notes: Empagliflozin in Heart Failure with a Preserved Ejection Fraction.

effect_quant.comparator: total HF hospitalizations in EMPEROR-Preserved with empagliflozin versus placebo

evidence.citation: Solomon SD et al 2022 N Engl J Med
evidence.notes: Dapagliflozin in Heart Failure with Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction.

effect_quant.comparator: worsening HF in DELIVER with dapagliflozin versus placebo

evidence.citation: Mayne KJ et al 2023 Br J Cardiol
evidence.notes: SGLT2 inhibitors in CKD and HFpEF: two new large trials and two new meta-analyses.
